{{Quote|When placed near living beings, the Seeds transmit signals that arouse irrational and violent impulses. The effect is slow, insidious and irreversible.|Darth Acina|<ref name="Buried" />}}
The '''Seeds of Rage''' were a set of [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifacts]] developed by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Fulminiss]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. 

==Description== 
A master of [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]], Fulminiss created the Seeds as the ultimate achievement in his lifelong quest to develop new ways to corrupt other living beings. The Seeds were designed to be buried underground, and used low-frequency transmissions amplified by the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] to subtly manipulate the emotions and thoughts of any living creatures nearby. Over time, the Seeds drove their victims insane and contaminated them with dark side energy, resulting in a warping of both the victims and the surrounding environment. Deformed, "[[Dread-seeded creature|dread-seeded]]" creatures unwillingly became guardians of the buried seeds.<ref name="Buried" />

==History==
{{Quote|The Dread Masters' agents are burying Seeds across the galaxy, where they will drive entire populations mad. We must recover those devices.|Darth Acina|<ref name="Buried" />}}
During the [[Galactic War]], Lord [[Tagriss]], a servant of the rogue [[Dread Masters]], [[Raid on the Arcanum|stole]] the seeds from [[Arcanum]] and spread across a number of settled worlds. [[Darth Acina]] of the [[Dark Council]] summoned an Imperial individual and tasked them with recovering the seeds. At the same time, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Cedral Gend]] summoned a Republic individual to find the seeds so that they could be destroyed.<ref name="Buried" />

==Behind the scenes==
After the final [[Confrontation on Ilum|mission]] on [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]], on the mission "Alchemy of Evil" Imperial players can choose to either use the corrupted Jedi forge to merge the seeds into a device that transforms into an armor at the end of the mission (dark side dialogue) or just return the seeds intact to Darth Acina, who will hide them in a more secure location on [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]] (light side dialogue). Republic players can also merge the Seeds (dark side dialogue), or they can bring the seeds to Cedral Gend who will then launch them into a nearby star (light side dialogue).
